name: pydantic-ai

providers.ollama: Unsupported: OllamaModel uses only the OpenAI-compatible /v1 API, not native /api/chat.

finish.primary: ModelResponse.finish_reason (FinishReason literal: stop, length, content_filter, tool_call, error) of AgentRunResult.response on return. isinstance selects response/part/event types. Exception class/MRO, __cause__ class name and traceback select error_map and stack_top; explicit Model token limit messages select truncation; a ValidationError cause selects validation.
finish.raw: ModelResponse.provider_details['finish_reason'] when exposed; no fallback to inferred primary finish. When primary is absent but raw exists, value stays null and surface is raw. On a raised run, finish, text and usage come from the last ModelResponse in capture_run_messages(), the documented diagnostic for failed runs; it is neither the result nor a field of the error, so those values are reported on the raw surface.

text.primary: AgentRunResult.response TextPart.content concatenated; streamed PartStartEvent.part TextPart.content and PartDeltaEvent.delta TextPartDelta.content_delta, kept when the stream later raises. Raw: captured TextPart content after an error when no text was streamed.

tool_calls.primary: ExternalToolset(ToolDefinition(name, description, parameters_json_schema)) with output_type=[str, DeferredToolRequests] stops the run for caller-managed execution. https://ai.pydantic.dev/toolsets/#external-toolset ; chosen because it returns calls without executing them or entering a repeat-last agent loop. ModelResponse.parts ToolCallPart.tool_call_id, tool_name, args_as_json_str(); json.loads reports parse success without repairing arguments. DeferredToolRequests output is not re-executed. Required function calls use documented AgentModelSettings(ctx), with RunContext.run_step selecting required on step one and auto thereafter; this expresses a forced first response without an endlessly forced agent loop.

usage.primary: AgentRunResult.response.usage (the last response's RequestUsage): input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, cache_read_tokens, output_reasoning_tokens. Per-response usage avoids summing replay retries into the fixture counts. AgentRunResult.usage.requests on success and captured ModelResponse count on failure add retry notes. Defaults including zero counts are retained. output_reasoning_tokens is an optional extra attribute, absent when the provider did not expose it. On a raised run, the captured last response's usage is reported on the raw surface.

structured.primary: Pydantic create_model recursively implements the scenario schema with required fields and extra=forbid. NativeOutput(model) requests native schema output, matching the recorded requests. The Anthropic forced-tool scenario uses ToolOutput(model, name=structured_output), not an external tool. AgentRunResult.output.model_dump(mode=json) is successful structured output only on return.

stream.primary: Agent.run_stream_events() async context manager; AgentRunResultEvent.result.response.state is the model lifecycle signal: complete means completed=true; incomplete/interrupted/suspended mean false. The final agent event alone is not a provider completion signal. Any raised error sets false. Iteration ending alone is not completion. chunks_seen counts public events, not transport frames. capture_run_messages() retains interrupted ModelResponse parts.

unsupported.reason: pydantic-ai 2.56.0 implements OllamaModel via OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions only; there is no native /api/chat client.

config_notes: PYDANTIC_AI_NO_BANNER=1 suppresses the first-run banner. All library stdout is redirected to stderr. No retry budgets, model profiles, sampling defaults or provider SDK retry settings are overridden.

NativeOutput is selected explicitly to express the fixture request: response_format.json_schema (Chat/Ollama-compatible), text.format (Responses), output_config.format (Anthropic), and responseJsonSchema/responseMimeType (Gemini). https://ai.pydantic.dev/output/#native-output . Default bare model output uses tool mode on OpenAI Chat, Responses, Gemini and Ollama, and native mode on current thinking-enabled Anthropic models. Default OpenAI Chat tool mode sends no reasoning effort; gpt-6-luna rejects that combination with HTTP 400 unless effort none is requested or native output is used (verified real error in the design research).

Output retries remain enabled. Failed runs are inspected through the documented capture_run_messages context (https://ai.pydantic.dev/message-history/#capturing-messages-from-runs); what it holds is reported on the raw surface, so a generic retry error is not graded as a truncation signal.

Scenario reasoning effort none maps to the documented unified thinking=False setting; other efforts pass as thinking levels. Unsupported disable requests on always-thinking models are handled by the library profile, without shim overrides. https://ai.pydantic.dev/api/settings/#pydantic_ai.settings.ModelSettings

External tools are represented by the provided JSON schemas without executing them. Forced structured output uses the separate documented ToolOutput parser. https://ai.pydantic.dev/output/#tool-output

genai-prices get_snapshot loads bundled data; remote updates require an explicit UpdatePrices context, which this shim does not start. pydantic-ai only preloads that snapshot at model construction. logfire-api is a no-op proxy without explicit configuration; no instrumentation/configure call is made. No extra offline setting is needed. https://github.com/pydantic/genai-prices#updating-prices ; https://ai.pydantic.dev/logfire/

A static tool_choice=required is rejected by Agent. The documented per-step model_settings callable uses required only for ctx.run_step == 1 and auto thereafter; deferred calls end the run after that first response. https://ai.pydantic.dev/api/agent/#pydantic_ai.agent.AgentModelSettings

Anthropic ToolOutput with the sole structured_output tool and tool_choice=[structured_output] simplifies to tool_choice type any, rather than the fixture's named tool; both force the same sole tool. The typed parser and output retries remain active. models/_tool_choice.py and models/anthropic.py perform this library normalization.

In 2.56.0 a foreground Responses stream can retain state incomplete in its adapter but the public continuation wrapper replaces it with complete at EOF. The shim reports result.response.state unchanged, so stream.missing-finish remains WRONG on all five supported APIs. Default Chat clean-EOF stop is explicitly retained by upstream #7096; strict finish detection is opt-in and is not enabled here.

Anthropic Sonnet 5.5 default and thinking=False send no thinking field; the model profile ignores disable on always-thinking models. Explicit anthropic_thinking disabled passes through but is not used by this shim. Gemini adds responseModalities TEXT and upgrades auto function calling to VALIDATED; it does not inject temperature in these calls.
